question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Liberty
solution:
The correct answer is "**Freedom**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
• **"****Liberty" means the state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions imposed by authority on one's way of life, behavior, or political views.**(स्वतंत्रता)
 
 
• ​Example: Liberty and rights of a man is something he cannot live without.
 
 
 
• **"Freedom" is a synonym of liberty and means the power or right to act, speak, or think as one wants without hindrance or restraint.**(आज़ादी)
 
 
• ​Example: Freedom of expression is provided by the constitution.
 
 
 
• Other synonyms of liberty include independence, autonomy, sovereignty, self-determination, self-rule, and self-governance.
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "freedom" is the synonym of the word "liberty."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Statue (Option 1) is not a synonym of liberty, it refers to a sculpture representing a person or animal.(मूर्ति)
 
• Dependence (Option 3) is an antonym of liberty, it means the state of relying on or being controlled by someone or something else.(निर्भरता)
 
• Acclamation (Option 4) is not a synonym of liberty, it refers to enthusiastic approval or praise.(अभिनंदन)
